subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs as the disabled-by-default canonical way to bound wedged deferred turn maintenance, or choose a different timeout/recovery policy before merge?
rationale: The code path is concrete and well covered, but adding a new config key and intentionally releasing same-session maintenance on timeout is a compatibility-sensitive product policy choice.

options.title: Accept this opt-in timeout
options.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix and treat positive turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs values as the operator-owned bound for wedged background maintenance.

options.title: Define a different policy
options.body: Pause the PR and specify a default, strict mode, shared compaction-timeout reuse, or recovery behavior that avoids this exact config surface.

options.title: Use another branch
options.body: Close or retarget this PR only if maintainers choose an overlapping PR or replacement branch as the proof-positive canonical implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept this opt-in timeout
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix and treat positive turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs values as the operator-owned bound for wedged background maintenance.

likelyOwner.reason: They contributed and merged the prior background turn-maintenance task-routing work, making them the strongest history-backed owner for this config/session-state policy choice.
